# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 44 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Radius — 4 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #333333);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #333333 | Page background. Body copy `ink` sits on it in both themes. Dark value is the grey-deep surface used by the dark color mode. |
| `--surface-subtle` | #fbfafb | #404040 | Card and panel background one step off `surface`. `ink` reads on it at 4.5:1 or better in both themes. |
| `--surface-border` | #ece9eb | #6a5d5d | Hairline dividers and card borders on `surface` and `surface-subtle`. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #333333);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #f3f3f3);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #333333;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #333333 | #f3f3f3 | Body copy and headings on `surface` and `surface-subtle`. 12.6:1 on white, 11.4:1 on the dark surface. |
| `--ink-muted` | #666666 | #dedede | Secondary text, meta lines and captions on `surface`. 5.7:1 on white, 9.4:1 on dark. Use instead of `grey-medium`, which fails AA for text. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--link, #cb3e85);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--link, #eecee3);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #cb3e85;
```

### Tokens (44)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--link` | #cb3e85 | #eecee3 | Link text on `surface`. Light value is `pink` (4.6:1 on white); dark value is `pink-light` (8.8:1 on the dark surface). Visited links keep this color. |
| `--link-hover` | #8d329f | #e0d2fe | Link hover, focus and active on `surface`. Light value is `purple` (6.8:1 on white); dark value is `purple-light`. |
| `--pink` | #cb3e85 | #cb3e85 | Primary brand color. Fills, buttons and accents; white text on it is 4.6:1. Not for text on the dark surface (2.8:1). |
| `--pink-deep` | #9e2968 | #9e2968 | Hover and pressed state for `pink` fills; white text on it is 7.1:1. |
| `--pink-medium` | #e690ac | #e690ac | Mid-tone pink for decorative fills and chart marks. No text on it. |
| `--pink-light` | #eecee3 | #eecee3 | Pale pink tint for highlighted rows and badges, with `ink` text. Link color on the dark surface. |
| `--purple` | #8d329f | #8d329f | Secondary brand color and link hover. White text on it is 6.8:1. |
| `--purple-deep` | #9b4f96 | #9b4f96 | Muted purple for borders and secondary fills. |
| `--purple-light` | #e0d2fe | #e0d2fe | Pale purple tint for highlights, with `ink` text. Link hover color on the dark surface. |
| `--plum` | #673147 | #673147 | Dark accent for footers and heavy headings on light surfaces. White text on it passes AA. |
| `--plum-light` | #efd3e3 | #efd3e3 | Pale plum tint for panels, with `ink` text. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 400 2rem/1.3 "Oswald", sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-heading-xl);
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heading-xl` | `.heading-xl`, `--text-heading-xl` | 2rem / 1.3 | 400 | `display` | Page titles. Oswald, sentence or title case as the content has it. |
| `heading-lg` | `.heading-lg`, `--text-heading-lg` | 1.5rem / 1.3 | 400 | `display` | Section headings. |
| `heading-md` | `.heading-md`, `--text-heading-md` | 1.25rem / 1.3 | 400 | `display` | Card titles and widget headings. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 1.25rem / 1.5 | 400 | `sans` | Lead paragraphs. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 1rem / 1.5 | 400 | `sans` | Default body copy. Open Sans on a 16px base. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 0.8125rem / 1.5 | 400 | `sans` | Meta lines, bylines and table cells. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 0.75rem / 1.5 | 400 | `sans` | Captions and badges. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Open Sans", sans-serif` |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Oswald", sans-serif` |
| `serif` | `--font-serif` | `Georgia, Times, "Times New Roman", serif` |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-sm: 0.25rem) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--radius-sm), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-sm` | 0.25rem | Most common border-radius in the theme: buttons, inputs, cards. |
| `--radius-md` | 10px | Larger panels and images. |
| `--radius-lg` | 14px | Feature cards. |
| `--radius-pill` | 999px | Pills, badges and tags. |
